issue.title: ImportError: cannot import name 'Styles' from 'structlog.dev' in Airflow 3.1.2
issue.body:
### Apache Airflow version

3.1.2

### If "Other Airflow 2/3 version" selected, which one?

_No response_

### What happened?

We are installing with the https://raw.githubusercontent.com/apache/airflow/constraints-3.1.2/constraints-3.10.txt constraints I'm able to verify that the version of Airflow is 3.1.2 (`airflow version` in working components).  I'm also able to verify `structlog==25.5.0` is installed.
Because of this issue we are unable to use Airflow 3.1.2. `structlog==25.5.0` is apparently not working, different from what we read in the release notes.

### What you think should happen instead?

Components should work correctly given right constraints and dependency installation.

comments.body:
Upstream issue : https://github.com/hynek/structlog/issues/769
This should be fixed with https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/57335

Backport commit 

commit 73e77abfeab1398c27e12760c45ef116608d345a
Author: Amogh Desai <amoghrajesh1999@gmail.com>
Date:   Mon Oct 27 16:43:24 2025 +0530

    Move structlog imports into a TYPE_CHECKING block to untie version bumps (#57335)
    
    (cherry picked from commit 08c317dd323a8b509c59fdfa65078fa8150bbbef)
I see apache-airflow-task-sdk==1.1.1 which I guess should be 1.1.2 . https://pypi.org/project/apache-airflow-task-sdk/1.1.2/

The task-sdk could also be bumped to >=1.1.2 in pyproject to force this.

https://github.com/apache/airflow/commit/6c3a1d5e2ba57478f3950eb637a586103015f625#diff-50c86b7ed8ac2cf95bd48334961bf0530cdc77b5a56f852c5c61b89d735fd711L69

https://github.com/apache/airflow/blob/7cbc8bfb1995b8aeb9f48f518d08cfeac001adc1/pyproject.toml#L68-L71

cc: @ashb @kaxil @ephraimbuddy @amoghrajesh
This effectively "broke" our Airflow installation. Had to roll back to 3.1.1 because of this.
You should likely be able to fix it in 3.1.2 by bumping task-sdk - apparently we have not bumped the version properly - see https://github.com/apache/airflow/issues/58006

Yeah. Making sure that you also add `apache-airflow-task-sdk==1.1.2` when you upgrade to 3.1.2 is a way to mitigate the issue - we already agreed that we will need a faster 3.1.3 with fixed approach for dependencies. 

I also manually updated constraints - to make it easy to see that task-sdk is needed in version 1.1.2 https://github.com/apache/airflow/commits/constraints-3.1.2/ - so if you use constraints (which is unlikely when you do upgrade, but still possible) - task-sdk will be upgraded to the right version.
I was able to verify that this indeed fixed the deployment. Thanks for the support!
